conclusions: Original NoteStore.getNotes enumerates every contract note and all staged notes even when siloedNullifier is supplied. An exact-key branch is a narrow feasible bound without a new store API.

Current draft starts original #readNote and #readNullifierEmission for the exact key, retaining staged precedence and the original filter/sort tail. Explicit contract equality is necessary and present because contract index selection is bypassed.

A general exact-key miss can return []; a missing cursor-authenticated expected head must still make terminal recovery fail rather than invent an uninitialized account. Existing broad index path must continue to reject corrupt missing rows.

One candidate does not independently establish uniqueness. Original NoteService.validateAndStoreNotes validates creation and nullifier inclusion against the operation anchor; only active candidates may be retained across a gap-free complete scan. Two active candidates must fail closed.

No generic ensureContractSynced bypass or syncedContracts complete flag may be inferred from this path. Authenticated compact completeness, cursor atomicity, canonical guard and final head/digest agreement remain separate mandatory conditions.
requiredTests: Exact-key query does not enumerate contract/staged history; staged note/emission precedence, scopes/status/owner/slot and explicit cross-contract mismatch behave like original filters.
Multiple actual revisions: old head found first but nullified at selected final anchor, latest head retained, terminal authenticated head and event digest exact.
Two active candidates reject; expected chosen head disappearing rejects; complete empty scan with actual key-gated uninitialized state remains the sole empty success.
Reorg restores/prunes both note and emission records and cursor consistently; failed coordinator commit does not advance cursor/mailbox or notes/events.
qualification: No source candidate approval or runtime test performed. Final committed diff and meaningful actual component/ACIR tests remain required.
